name: Split
action: Compare 13 single orbit deletions, nested deletions and central-times-quartet interventions.

name: Falsify
action: Search nonreal Fourier zeros from a fixed complex grid; one stable root falsifies the frozen deletion hunch.

name: Reverse
action: Reinsert each removed factor algebraically; test a literal-source evaluation as reconstruction control, without counting it as discovery.

name: Viewpoint
action: Treat source zeros as removable structural units, Fourier zeros as their collective response; include conjugate and negative images.

name: Visual
action: Save complex root coordinates and scaled real Fourier profiles for a phase portrait after validation.

name: Action
action: Delete complete source symmetry orbits by polynomial division; no artificial pole on real integration line.

name: Essentials
action: Retain literal infinite theta series and fast tails, positivity/evenness on real axis. Normalize mass only.

name: Similar
action: Compare imaginary-axis orbit with genuine off-axis quartets; no generic Gaussian is a discovery target.

name: Small
action: Literal control and single central orbit are pilot; all 13 singles test individuality.

name: Extreme
action: Remove every known orbit, or all except one; no assertion these exhaust strip zeros.

name: Experiment
action: 50-digit discrete trapezoidal cosine integration, root iteration and saved failures; 14 workers, whole-family cap.

name: Invariant
action: Record real positivity, evenness, mass normalization, exact list of retained/deleted node orbits.

name: Monotone
action: Test whether earliest nonreal witness and real-root counts behave monotonically along fixed nested subsets; no theorem assumed.

name: Weaker bridge
action: Finite searched-window zero reality is only numerical evidence and never replaces global hunch.

name: Stronger hunch
action: Do not repair failed deletion law by selecting favorable node groups. A new group-composition law requires separate freezing.

name: Minimal counterexample
action: If mixed deletion fails, compare both constituent single deletions and leave-one-in cases.

name: Representation
action: Polynomial multiplication on source equals a constant-coefficient differential operator on transform. Use identity only for independent checks.

name: Technique
action: Cross-field defect-constituent viewpoint from arXiv2606.21479; no smectic theorem transfers. Deep corpus source-method search archived.

name: Fake proof
action: Positive even residual has real Fourier zeros is invalid. Missing step is a source-specific preservation law, not symmetry.

name: Missing lemma
action: Deletion preserves spectral zero reality for actual theta-source divisor; completely open, not supplied as assumption to a proof claim.

name: Dependency
action: Certified source nodes -> analytic quotient -> certified transform roots or a preservation law -> reconstruction; off-axis quartet reconstruction itself is an additional obstacle.

name: Nearby false
action: Off-axis quartets versus pure imaginary orbit, mixed versus separate; arbitrary symmetry-preserving counterexamples are already known and not a target.

name: Boundary
action: Classify root-search domain escape, iteration failure, small derivatives and precision disagreement separately from absence.

name: Salvage
action: If hunch fails, isolate smallest tested deletion set and its reciprocal reconstruction; ask whether divisor-residual coupling, rather than zero-free residual, carries spectral reality.
